UNDERSTAND EACH REPORT
•Blueprint: Your fixed CosmoKundli pattern at birth.
•Diagnosis: Evaluates Blueprint and flags for GRAHs’ remedy needs.
•Vibes: Tracks the trend of quality of each GRAH’s vibration over time.
•Intensity: Shows how strongly a GRAH gets activated
•Planner: Personalised Sentiment & Situation guidance for better decisions
•Planner Plus and Planner Max: Sentiment, Situation and additional 5D
coverage across Career, Finance, Health, Social and Love
